request.what: Annual funding for maintenance and enhancement of MLabs Core Tool Maintenance & Enhancement: Plutarch and Ply.

claims.claim: Plutarch is a Haskell eDSL for creating efficient Cardano smart contracts through controlled compilation into UPLC, and Ply serializes Plutarch scripts to and from CIP-57 blueprint-style artifacts with inferred types.
MLabs counted at least 26 teams building with Plutarch and Ply in a recent internal audit, while the rationale section says it conservatively counted at least 15 teams.
Plutarch scripts rank among the smallest in MLabs' public cross-language benchmark suite while requiring comparatively low on-chain compute and memory.

The proposal prioritizes resources first to critical breakages and serious vulnerabilities, then protocol-era and hard-fork compatibility, then bug fixes, correctness improvements, optimizations, documentation, examples, technical blog posts, and developer-experience improvements.

The proposal says the requested 1,162,746 ADA consists of 1,128,880 ADA for Plutarch and Ply maintenance, compatibility, and developer experience, plus a 33,866 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The requested amount does not at submission, alone or in aggregate, breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are described as being handled through Intersect, technically capable third parties, and Intersect's administration fee.

The proposal discloses prior MLabs funding from named treasury or governance sources, Project Catalyst Fund9 and Fund13 amounts, and a prior 70,000 ADA Intersect grant for Conway-era Plutarch updates.

Intersect plans to administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, role-based authorization thresholds, named oversight committee entities, and a public dashboard for community auditing.

summary: The document requests 1,162,746 ADA for annual Plutarch and Ply maintenance and enhancement, submitted by Intersect on behalf of MLabs, with stated work priorities, budget summary, prior funding disclosures, NCL compliance claims, and smart-contract-based administration details.
